title: Prince2 and RUP: where they still show up

videos.script: Sooner or later you will read a contract that mentions a Project Board, or a phase called elaboration. {{contract}} Those words come from two methods most developers never learned: PRINCE2, from the British government, and RUP, from the people who made UML. {{two}} PRINCE2's best idea is management by exception. Each level sets the level below some room to work, and hears from it only when a forecast says the room will run out. {{exception}} RUP's best idea is elaboration. Prove the architecture with running code, early, on the riskiest decisions. {{elaboration}} This lesson takes the useful idea out of each method, and ends with a table for reading any process document, whatever vocabulary it was written in. {{table}}
